Furniture lift hire

When the stairs or lift
are not enough.

CODEM hires out furniture lifts with an operator to households and businesses, by the half-day or day. A lift brings furniture through an upper-floor window when there is no lift, the lift is too small or corridors are narrow.

Sofas, wardrobes, pianos and other bulky items can be raised or lowered with suitable equipment, operated by a specialist technician.

  • Less risk to furniture and shared areas
  • For households and businesses
  • Parking and street constraints assessed

Start my quote

The right care.
The right preparation.

01

Assess the location.

The floor, opening dimensions, facade and available ground space determine feasibility. An intervention is confirmed only after assessment.

02

Plan parking and positioning.

Vehicle positioning and any required occupancy permissions need advance planning. Tell us about known restrictions so the intervention can be prepared.

03

Match handling to your furniture.

Dimensions, weight and fragility are assessed to identify suitable equipment. A furniture lift is one option to consider, not a universal solution.

Let’s plan your move

Your questions.
A place to start.

I don’t know my moving volume. What should I do ?

Share your floor area, number of rooms and main furniture items. Select “I don’t know” in the quote form if needed. CODEM will assess the volume with you.

What if access is difficult ?

Tell us about floors, lifts, stairs and parking. Suitable equipment, including a furniture lift, is assessed against access conditions and any necessary permissions.

Can you pack fragile items ?

Dishes, artwork, mirrors and sensitive equipment can receive suitable protection as part of the agreed service. Mention any specialist items when you first contact us.

Are packing and unpacking included ?

This depends on the selected package and services. Your quote specifies what CODEM handles and what you prepare yourself.

Can I arrange temporary storage ?

Yes. Tell us the volume you need to store and the intended duration. Storage, collection and return arrangements are agreed with CODEM.

Which destinations do you serve ?

Paris, Greater Paris, France and European destinations including Spain, Portugal and Italy. Each route is assessed according to destination, volume and access.
